definitions.gloss: dialogue skills; ability to engage in productive conversation
definitions.explanation: The skill or capacity to communicate effectively through dialogue, including listening, responding thoughtfully, and building mutual understanding. Frequently discussed in education, business, and diplomacy.

examples.japanese: {対話力|たいわりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}めたい→高める：02065_takameru⟧。
examples.english: I want to improve my dialogue skills.

examples.japanese: ⟦リーダー→リーダー：24312_riidaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{対話力|たいわりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。

examples.english: This training aims to develop dialogue skills for drawing out the other person's opinions.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{対話|たいわ}→対話：12400_taiwa⟧ (dialogue) + {力|りょく} (power/ability). Part of a productive pattern in Japanese where ～{力|りょく} creates nouns meaning "ability to do X." This word has become common in business and education contexts, especially in discussions about leadership and interpersonal skills.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {対話力|たいわりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧: to improve dialogue skills
- {対話力|たいわりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}につける→身につける：03158_minitsukeru⟧: to acquire dialogue skills
- {対話力|たいわりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問|と}われる→問う：02299_tou⟧: dialogue skills are put to the test
- {対話力|たいわりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a person with good communication skills

RELATED ～{力|りょく} COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{会話力|かいわりょく}→会話力：23778_kaiwaryoku⟧: conversational ability — broader, includes casual chat
- {傾聴力|けいちょうりょく}: active listening skills — the listening component of dialogue
- ⟦{交渉力|こうしょうりょく}→交渉力：23366_koushouryoku⟧: negotiation skills — more adversarial, goal-oriented
- ⟦{発信力|はっしんりょく}→発信力：18715_hasshinryoku⟧: ability to communicate outward — one-directional, unlike dialogue
